visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair and a headset is seen in a small rectangular inset in the top left corner, set against a background of bookshelves. The main frame displays a first-person perspective of a dark, dimly lit room with peeling wallpaper and scattered debris. A wooden coffee table sits in the center of a tiled floor with some broken pieces. (2) The camera moves through a narrow, dark hallway with stained walls. A pale, ghostly figure of an old woman with a wide, disturbing grin peeks out from behind a door frame. The man in the inset smiles and laughs while looking at the screen. Yellow Traditional Chinese text overlays appear periodically at the bottom and center. (3) The scene transitions to a dilapidated public restroom with tiled walls and several squat-style toilet stalls. The perspective shifts as if the character is crouching or looking around the confined space. A single bare light bulb hangs from the ceiling, casting harsh shadows. More yellow variety-show captions and subtitles appear to reflect the man's commentary. (4) The view moves inside a dark toilet stall. After a sequence of knocking, the camera looks over the top of the wooden partition. The creepy old woman figure is seen peering back over the edge, her head tilted at an unnatural angle. Later, she appears looking from under a bed in a dark room with a green night-vision filter.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks in Mandarin with a calm but expectant tone, accompanied by soft, heavy footsteps on a hard tiled surface. Low-frequency ambient drones create a tense, horror-themed atmosphere. No structured BGM is present initially, only the atmospheric environmental room tone of the game. (2) A sharp, mid-frequency metallic thud triggers a transition. The speaker lets out a sudden, high-pitched laugh and exclaims in Mandarin. The laughter is energetic and rhythmic. Background music remains minimal, consisting of subtle, dissonant synth pads that swell slightly in volume during visual movements. (3) The sound of rhythmic footsteps continues, interspersed with the speaker's humorous commentary. A percussive 'knocking' sound—a sharp, wooden impact—occurs three times in a clear pattern. The speaker's voice rises in pitch and volume, exhibiting high arousal during moments of comedic tension. (4) A loud, high-frequency jump-scare SFX plays, characterized by a sudden burst of white noise and dissonant strings. The speaker laughs loudly again, his vocal valence remaining positive despite the horror context. The audio sequence concludes with the sound of a mechanical click and fading laughter.
